p: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me
a: in righteousness, and in judgment
s: , and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
d: in truth and in everlasting peace
with songs of joyful thanksgiving
before the presence of my people

p: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and
a: thou shalt know the LORD
d: thy soul shall dwell in peace
he will show thee his mercy
his truth shall be thy shield

a: Come, and let us return unto the LORD
s: : for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
d: Seek ye the God of Jacob while he may be found
Praise ye the name of the Almighty for ever
Turn again, O Israel, from the path of evil

p: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for
a: there is no saviour beside me
d: my holy throne is from everlasting
I have redeemed thy soul from death
beside my name there is none else

p: O Israel,
a: return unto the LORD thy God
s: ; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
d: walk in all his commandments
offer pure sacrifices of peace
cleave unto his holy covenant

p: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and
a: receive us graciously
s: : so will we render the calves of our lips.
d: pardon our iniquities
heal all our backslidings
remember thy covenant

p: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for
a: the ways of the LORD are right
s: , and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
d: the counsel of God shall stand
his holy judgments are true
the path of wisdom is peace

a: Sanctify ye a fast
s: , call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD,
d: Blow ye the trumpet
Call upon the Lord
Gather the people

p: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for
a: the LORD will do great things
d: his holy arm shall deliver you
the King of heaven will give peace
his tender mercies shall abound

p: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears:
a: let the weak say, I am strong
d: let the poor rejoice in the Lord
let the sorrowful sing of his grace
let the humble praise his holy name

p: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be
a: the hope of his people
s: , and the strength of the children of Israel.
d: a shield unto Israel
the rock of salvation
a helper in trouble

p: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and
a: the hills shall flow with milk
s: , and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
d: the valleys shall shout for joy
the pastures shall bring forth increase
the land shall be filled with peace

p: And he said,
a: The LORD will roar from Zion
s: , and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
d: The King of heaven cometh with power
The holy One of Israel shall judge
His mighty voice shall shake the earth

a: The lion hath roared, who will not fear?
s: the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
d: The trumpet hath sounded, who will not hear?
The day of the Lord cometh, who can abide?
The holy God hath spoken, who can doubt?

p: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel,
a: Seek ye me, and ye shall live
d: Turn unto my law, and find peace
Keep my commandments, and prosper
Hear my holy word, and be healed

a: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live
s: ; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.
d: Trust in his name, and find rest
Call upon his mercy, and be saved
Walk in his statutes, and have peace

a: Hate the evil, and love the good
s: , and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
d: Cleave unto truth, and walk in peace
Turn from pride, and seek humility
Depart from sin, and honor the Lord

p: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and
a: they shall build the waste cities
s: , and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
d: they shall restore the holy temple
they shall walk in righteous peace
they shall offer pure sacrifices

p: And
a: I will plant them upon their land
s: , and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.
d: I will give them peace in their borders
they shall dwell safely in their cities
my mercy shall compass them about

p: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom;
a: We have heard a rumour from the LORD
s: , and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
d: A vision of the Almighty was declared
The word of the holy prophet came to pass
The judgment of heaven is revealed this day

p: Behold, I have made thee
a: small among the heathen
s: : thou art greatly despised.
d: a reproach to the nations
desolate in thy borders
fallen from thy pride

p: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD,
a: even destroy the wise men out of Edom
s: , and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
d: cut off the princes of the strangers
scatter the host of the ungodly
bring down the pride of the haughty

p: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob
a: shame shall cover thee
s: , and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
d: judgment shall fall upon thee
fear shall compass thy house
sorrow shall overtake thy soul

p: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and
a: I fear the LORD, the God of heaven
s: , which hath made the sea and the dry land.: or, JEHOVAH
d: I worship the Almighty King of all
I serve the living God of Abraham
My hope is in the Holy One of Jacob

p: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I,
a: and thou heardest my voice
d: and deliveredst my soul
and showedst thy mercy
and healedst my plague

p: When my soul fainted within me
a: I remembered the LORD
s: : and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
d: I cried unto my God
my heart sought peace
I turned unto him

p: So
a: the people of Nineveh believed God
s: , and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
d: the king of Assyria bowed in fear
the princes of the city repented
all the inhabitants wept aloud

p: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that
a: thou art a gracious God, and merciful
s: , slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
d: thy throne is established in righteousness
great is thy lovingkindness toward Israel
thy holy name is exalted above the heavens

p: For, behold,
a: the LORD cometh forth out of his place
s: , and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
d: the King of glory shall judge the earth
the Holy One will reveal his mighty arm
the God of Jacob descendeth from heaven

p: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings?
a: do not my words do good
s: to him that walketh uprightly?
d: shall not his truth abide
doth not his mercy endure
is not his promise sure

p: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and
a: to the house of the God of Jacob
s: ; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
d: before the altar of his holy temple
unto the sanctuary of the living King
into the courts of everlasting praise

p: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk
a: in the name of the LORD our God
s: for ever and ever.
d: before the throne of his holy temple
according to all his commandments
with songs of everlasting joy

p: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and
a: the LORD shall reign over them
s: in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
d: the King of glory shall judge
his holy arm shall deliver them
his peace shall never be moved

p: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and
a: bow myself before the high God?
s: shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
d: offer pure praise unto the Lord?
enter into his glorious presence?
make my supplication in faith?

p: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness,
a: the LORD shall be a light unto me
d: his holy arm shall lift up my soul
the God of my salvation will save me
his tender mercy shall compass my path

a: God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth
s: ; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies. is a jealous God, and a revenger, etc
d: The Almighty is righteous in judgment
The Holy One will not acquit the wicked
The King of heaven will plead his cause

p: He
a: rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry
s: , and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
d: ruleth the heavens in his great power
maketh the clouds his holy chariot
judgeth the earth in righteous equity

a: The mountains quake at him
s: , and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
d: The earth trembleth in fear
The pillars of heaven shake
The depths of the sea roar

p: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end:
a: affliction shall not rise up the second time
d: his adversaries shall be consumed as stubble
the decree of the ungodly shall be broken
the kingdom of the oppressor is brought down

p: Thus saith the LORD; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee,
a: I will afflict thee no more
d: my wrath is turned away
I will heal thy wound
thy peace shall abound

p: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for
a: I will work a work in your days
s: , which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
d: I will reveal my arm to the nations
the day of judgment cometh quickly
my word shall accomplish all my will

p: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and
a: make it plain upon tables
s: , that he may run that readeth it.
d: declare it unto all nations
proclaim it with holy fear
seal it until the time

p: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because
a: it will surely come, it will not tarry
d: the word of the Lord shall not fail
the vision of heaven shall be fulfilled
his righteous decree is established forever

p: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known;
a: in wrath remember mercy
d: in judgment show thy love
forgive our secret sins
look down from heaven

p: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy
a: in the God of my salvation
d: in the rock of my refuge
in the King of my praise
in the Lord of my peace

p: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for
a: the day of the LORD is at hand
s: : for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
d: the judgment of heaven cometh soon
the holy King shall reveal his arm
the time of righteousness is near

a: The great day of the LORD is near
s: , it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
d: The holy judgment of heaven cometh
The glorious kingdom shall be revealed
The day of his wrath shall overtake them

p: I will also leave in the midst of thee
a: an afflicted and poor people
s: , and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.
d: a holy and humble nation
a remnant of true worship
a chosen and faithful seed

a: Sing, O daughter of Zion
s: ; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
d: Rejoice, O chosen people
Shout aloud, O Israel
Praise the holy King

p: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the LORD, is in the midst of thee:
a: thou shalt not see evil any more
d: thy peace shall endure forevermore
his holy presence will deliver thee
the fear of the enemy is taken away

p: Thus saith the LORD of hosts;
a: Consider your ways
d: Remember my law
Sanctify your heart
Keep my covenant

a: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood
s: , and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.
d: Enter into the courts with thanksgiving
Offer sacrifices upon his holy altar
Gather the elders of the congregation

p: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him, and
a: the people did fear before the LORD
d: the elders kept the holy covenant
the priests offered sweet incense
all the host bowed in thanksgiving

p: Then spake Haggai the LORD's messenger in the LORD's message unto the people, saying,
a: I am with you, saith the LORD
d: Fear not the faces of the heathen
My holy promise shall not fail
My spirit remaineth among you

p: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so
a: my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not
d: my holy presence shall protect your city
my covenant shall stand with all your seed
my righteous arm will scatter your enemies

p: Therefore thus saith the LORD;
a: I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies
s: : my house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
d: My holy throne shall be established
The glory of the Lord shall be seen
Peace shall be within her sacred gates

a: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD
s: : for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
d: Bow down, all ye nations, before the King
Praise ye the name of the most High God
Give thanks unto the Rock of our salvation

p: For who hath despised
a: the day of small things?
s: for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth. shall rejoice
d: the promise of his word?
the house of his glory?
the counsel of the Lord?

p: Thus saith the LORD;
a: I am returned unto Zion
s: , and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.
d: I will heal my people
My peace is established
My glory is revealed

p: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold,
a: I will save my people
s: from the east country, and from the west country;
d: I will heal their land
my peace shall abide
my arm will defend

p: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God,
a: in truth and in righteousness
d: with all their whole heart
in holy peace and praise
under my mighty hand

p: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts;
a: therefore love the truth and peace
d: walk in his holy commandments
offer pure sacrifices of joy
cleave unto the living God

p: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father,
a: where is mine honour?
s: and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
d: why do ye sin?
where is your fear?
why doubt ye me?

p: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same
a: my name shall be great among the Gentiles
s: ; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.
d: pure incense shall arise unto my throne
all the ends of the earth shall fear me
holy offerings shall be brought to my house

a: The law of truth was in his mouth
s: , and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.
d: The word of life was upon his lips
The holy covenant was in his heart
The praise of God was his strength

p: And he shall sit as
a: a refiner and purifier of silver
s: : and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
d: a righteous king in holy power
a faithful judge of his house
a helper unto the fatherless

p: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day
a: when I make up my jewels
s: ; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
d: when I visit my people
when I reveal my glory
when I establish peace
